fusions.name: Snap from the Doldrums
fusions.desc: A sudden bite that deals 13 damage, leaves the target [Stunned] for 1 second and 10% easier to wound for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Jettisoned Tail
fusions.desc: Costs 5% of your maximum health: flings a shed tail into the first enemy it meets, and it deals 8 damage.

fusions.name: Basking on the Hatch
fusions.desc: Restores 4 health a second to you for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Noon Watch
fusions.desc: By day, your damage rises by 10%.
